launch.title: Determine quantity from photos
launch.description: Calculate the quantity from a photo and verify the result before booking.

header.description: Spread pieces out, shoot from above, and avoid overlaps where possible.

bulk.description: Experimental estimate for overlapping and hidden parts, without a counted reference sample.
bulk.intro: One part type, one box, several viewpoints.
bulk.guide: Take 3–5 photos: from above, obliquely from one side and from the opposite side. Include the whole container, rim and fill surface. Additional side views help with hidden layers. Keep the container and contents unchanged between photos.
bulk.privacy: 3–5 photos, up to 8 MB each. Photos are sent to the configured AI provider for analysis and are not saved as item images.
bulk.dimensionsHelp: Dimensions can improve the estimate. Enter all three values in millimetres for a group, or leave the group empty. For hollow parts, use outer dimensions, not filament volume.
bulk.partDimensions: Outer dimensions of a typical part
bulk.insufficient: More evidence is needed for a total estimate
bulk.accuracy: Uncalibrated visual estimate. This range is not a statistically validated interval; accuracy within 15% has not been demonstrated.

errors.dimensions: Enter all three dimensions greater than 0 and up to 10,000 mm for each group, or leave the entire group empty.
errors.photos: Add at least three photos from different angles.
errors.upload: Use 3–5 readable photos, up to 8 MB each. Reduce the resolution of large files.
errors.invalidRequest: The inputs could not be read. Check photos and dimensions.
errors.notConfigured: Box estimation has no AI connection configured yet. An administrator can configure OpenAI access.
errors.unavailable: Analysis is temporarily unavailable. Please try again.
errors.conflict: The inputs for this attempt have changed. Start the estimate again.
errors.processing: This analysis is still running. Wait briefly, then click “Estimate total quantity” again to retrieve the same result.
errors.disabled: Photo counting has been disabled by an administrator.
errors.rateLimit: The request limit has been reached. Wait briefly and try again.
errors.budget: The monthly AI budget has been reached.
errors.analysisFailed: The analysis returned no valid result. You can start it again.
errors.timeout: The response is taking longer than expected. Clicking again retries the same attempt.
errors.duplicatePhotos: The same photo was selected more than once. Use different viewpoints.

bulk.analysisHelp: Two separate image analyses assess layers and volume. Both may make the same visual error; this is not a measured 3D reconstruction.

threeD.description: Experimental 3D reconstruction from 3–4 photos with manual image annotations.
threeD.guide: Photograph the same unchanged bin from above and from two or three oblique angles. The first photo must show the fill surface, individual parts and the table around the bin. Then outline the fill surface, mark at least three part lengths and three table points.
threeD.privacy: 3–4 photos, at most 8 MB each. Processed on the application’s configured 3D computer. Photos are removed after the attempt; results remain accessible for 24 hours and are cleaned up during subsequent use.

markHelp.pile: Place at least four points in order around the visible area containing parts. Exclude bin walls.
markHelp.edges: For at least three clearly visible parts, mark both ends of the same longest edge. Choose complete parts from different image areas.
markHelp.table: Place three widely separated points on the same flat table surface outside the bin. They must not lie on one line.

threeD.markSecond: Now mark the other end of this part.
threeD.markPhoto: Top view for marking the fill surface, part lengths and table
threeD.markKeyboard: Annotate image: arrow keys move the crosshair, Shift moves faster, Enter places a point.
threeD.shapeLabel: Approximate outer shape of one part
threeD.assumptionsHelp: These values are assumptions, not measurements. Width and height are relative to the marked part length. Hollow and interlocking parts may cause large errors. No correction factor from earlier test counts is applied.

parameters.packing: Fraction of fill volume occupied by outer part shapes
parameters.floorOffset: Interior bottom above table (in part lengths)

phases.analyzing: Analyzing fill volume and part size…

threeD.waitHelp: The job runs in the background and can take several minutes including model startup. After a connection error you can retrieve the same job again.
threeD.accuracy: Uncalibrated. The previous spacer test underestimated the count by 57%. Accuracy within ±15% has not been demonstrated; this range is not a confidence interval.

warnings.hiddenBottom: The interior bottom is hidden beneath the parts. Its height remains an assumption.
warnings.partShape: Outer part shapes and gaps are approximated. Hidden parts are not counted individually.
warnings.manualMarks: The calculation depends on your image annotations and shape assumptions.
warnings.geometry: The annotations or reconstructed geometry do not support a quantity. Review table points, fill outline and part lengths.
warnings.sampleSpread: The marked part lengths differ substantially. Perspective, occlusion or mixed parts may distort the estimate.

threeD.acknowledge: I have reviewed the assumptions and uncertainty and will check the quantity before booking.
threeD.provenance: MapAnything · {{images}} photos · {{samples}} manually marked size examples
threeD.modelAlt: Rotatable reconstruction of the visible bin and fill surface
threeD.modelError: The 3D preview could not be loaded. You can download the model.
threeD.modelHelp: Drag to rotate; use the wheel or two fingers to zoom. The model contains visible surfaces; hidden parts are absent.

errors.marks: Add the first three photos and mark a fill outline, at least three complete part lengths and three widely separated table points.
errors.upload: Use readable JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF or HEIC photos, at most 8 MB each.
errors.invalidRequest: The image annotations or assumptions are invalid. Please review the inputs.
errors.notConfigured: 3D processing has not been configured yet. An administrator must enable the MapAnything computer.
errors.unavailable: The job is currently unreachable. Retrieving it again will not start a second reconstruction.
errors.duplicatePhotos: The same photo was selected more than once. Use different viewpoints.
errors.conflict: This attempt belongs to different inputs. Start the analysis again.
errors.processing: The job is still being created. Try retrieving it again shortly.
errors.disabled: Photo counting has been disabled by the administrator.
errors.rateLimit: The request limit has been reached. Try again later.
errors.analysisFailed: 3D processing failed. Check the photos; an administrator can inspect the processing log.
errors.expired: This result has expired. Start a new reconstruction.
errors.notFound: This job is unavailable or you no longer have access.
